description: Builds a construction stage sequence with the Construction Stage Wizard plugin's bulk generator and writes it with its stage planner (which keeps composite sections and construction-stage load combinations intact, rewriting and restoring them when CIVIL NX would otherwise delete them). Structure groups are activated in order, groupsPerStage at a time; boundary and load groups (e.g. supports, self weight) ride in the first new stage; an optional temporary group per stage (e.g. a form traveller) is switched on and off with it; an optional final stage closes the sequence. mode 'append' adds after the model's existing stages; 'replace' replaces them all. Every stage is validated against the model's groups first. Previews unless apply: true; the write keeps a snapshot for stages_undo.

age.description: Material age at activation, days; null follows the stage duration.

apply.description: Write to CIVIL NX. Only after the user approved the preview.

boundaryGroups.description: Boundary groups activated in the first new stage (deformed position).

confirmPlanHash.description: planHash from the approved preview; the write is refused if the plan differs.

durations.description: Days per stage; several values repeat as a pattern (e.g. [7, 7, 14]). Default [7].

finalStage.description: {name, duration, steps}: a closing stage, e.g. long-term with time steps.

groupPrefix.description: Instead of groups: every structure group whose name starts with this, in natural order (Seg_2 before Seg_10).

loadGroups.description: Load groups activated in the first new stage (e.g. self weight).

naming.description: {template:'CS{INDEX}', start, pad}. In append mode start defaults to after the last existing stage.

temporary.description: {family:'load'|'boundary', groups:[one per stage]}: on in its stage, off in the next.

name: construction_stages
title: Construction Stage Wizard — stage sequence
